newsitem.title: USA: U.S. DOE sets electricity restructuring meetings.
newsitem.headline: U.S. DOE sets electricity restructuring meetings.

text.p: The U.S. Department of Energy announced Friday plans to hold four public meetings across the country to help the Clinton administration craft electricity restructuring legislation for submission to Congress next year.
"Many difficult issues must be addressed as we build a foundation for the new U.S. electricity industry," said U.S. Energy Secretary Hazel O'Leary.
The first meeting will be held Oct. 10 in the New Brunswick, N.J., area and will focus on public issues such as environmental protection and consumer interest.
A second meeting will be Oct 22. in Santa Fe, N.M., with a focus on jurisdiction and rate regulation including stranded cost recovery.
DOE said two more meetings will be held in November, one on the topics of reliability and competition in retail markets and another aimed at full overview of restructuring issues.
